fetch_20newsgroups: fetch the 20 newsgroups dataset with train/test subsets, categories, and text cleaning options
fetch_20newsgroups_vectorized: fetch and vectorize the 20 newsgroups dataset using CountVectorizer with normalized sparse features
strip_newsgroup_header: strip newsgroup headers from text by removing everything before the first blank line
strip_newsgroup_quoting: strip quoted lines from newsgroup text using regex patterns for quote markers and attribution lines
strip_newsgroup_footer: strip signature blocks from newsgroup text by finding and removing trailing footer sections
